businessRules: A catalog is stored as a single .ecatm file (SQLite database with embedded images)
Everything runs client-side in the browser - no backend required
Hotspot Address must be unique across the entire catalog
Multiple hotspots can share the same Address when the same part appears multiple times
A table row is linked to hotspot(s) via the Address field
A hotspot can either link to a table row OR navigate to another image, not both
Password-protected catalogs require HTTPS (or localhost) for encryption
Quiz mode requires Extra key 'correct' = 1 to mark right answers, optional 'need' for multiple correct answers
Grid Composer requires photos named numerically (1.jpg, 2.jpg) matching No. column in table
Undo/Redo buttons are disabled when there's nothing to undo/redo
Cart button is disabled when cart is empty
Demo files cannot be modified (delete buttons disabled)
Search can filter by specific fields (Name, SKU, Description, or Extra keys)
Store settings allow different catalog types: Commercial, Education, Fitness, Booking, Quiz
Buy button behavior can be 'Add to cart' or 'Go straight to payment'
Default view setting only affects narrow screens/embeds

testScenarios.name: Create new catalog and add image with hotspot
testScenarios.description: Create a new catalog via 'New catalog' button, add an image, place a hotspot on it, fill in link details and table row data, then save

testScenarios.name: Edit existing hotspot position and data
testScenarios.description: Open demo catalog, click on a hotspot to edit, drag it to new position, modify name/address, apply changes and verify undo/redo works

testScenarios.name: Search functionality across catalog
testScenarios.description: Open furniture catalog, use Search to find items by name, SKU, and extra fields, verify filtering by specific field works

testScenarios.name: Cart workflow in viewer
testScenarios.description: Add multiple items to cart, verify cart count updates, open cart dropdown, verify Buy links work, use Clear cart and verify cart empties

testScenarios.name: Hotspot-table row highlighting sync
testScenarios.description: Click a hotspot and verify corresponding table row highlights, click table row and verify hotspot highlights

testScenarios.name: Navigation hotspot between images
testScenarios.description: Open living-room catalog, click a navigation hotspot that opens another image, verify correct image loads

testScenarios.name: Quiz mode answer validation
testScenarios.description: Open quiz catalog, click answer options, verify correct answers turn green and incorrect turn red, verify score updates

testScenarios.name: Grid Composer complete workflow
testScenarios.description: Set catalog name and settings, upload photos, load table data, verify report shows no errors, export catalog

testScenarios.name: Duplicate hotspot address validation
testScenarios.description: Try to create two hotspots with different addresses that should be unique, then try to change one to match another's address

testScenarios.name: Empty catalog name
testScenarios.description: Try to create a new catalog with empty name, verify validation behavior

testScenarios.name: Grid Composer missing photos
testScenarios.description: Load table data without photos, verify Report section shows appropriate error message

testScenarios.name: Grid Composer mismatched photo numbers
testScenarios.description: Load table with No. values that don't match photo file names, verify validation report

testScenarios.name: Invalid password for protected catalog
testScenarios.description: Open password-protected catalog, enter wrong password, verify error message

testScenarios.name: Export protected without HTTPS

testScenarios.name: Unsaved changes warning

testScenarios.name: Large image upload handling

testScenarios.name: XSS in catalog name or hotspot data

testScenarios.name: Malicious URL in buy_url field
testScenarios.description: Enter javascript: URL or data: URL in buy_url extra field, verify it's sanitized or blocked

testScenarios.name: Remote catalog URL validation

testScenarios.name: Password-protected catalog brute force
testScenarios.description: Attempt multiple wrong passwords on protected catalog, verify no rate limiting bypass possible
